subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A band used AI to create possible melodies for a new song.”?
options: When fans learned AI had been used, some were upset.
Grandma still used the assistant, but she learned to check important actions before confirming them.
The restaurant learned that translation is not only changing words.
Agriculture students visited the farm and learned about crop diversity.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「When fans learned AI had been used, some were upset.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Grandma still used the assistant, but she learned to check important actions before confirming them.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The restaurant learned that translation is not only changing words.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Agriculture students visited the farm and learned about crop diversity.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「When fans learned AI had been used, some were upset.」，答案為「When fans learned AI had been used, some were upset.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When fans learned AI had been used, some were upset.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
